Process

How a Lahore project runs

1

Tell us about the space

Call, WhatsApp or email with drawings, photos or a rough idea. We shape the brief together.

2

Site visit or drawings review

We measure the site ourselves, since we are local. Drawings you already have work just as well.

3

Concept & quantities

You see the design in 3D and approve itemized quantities before anything is built.

4

Build & handover

One team delivers the work and hands over a finished space that matches what you approved.

A local note

A note on working in Lahore

Lahore is our home studio city, so everything runs from here: the design team, the showroom at Zainab Tower and the material library our projects are specified from. Site visits are quick to arrange, and most clients visit us before work begins. We work across DHA, Model Town, Gulberg and beyond.
